test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The sentence given below has one misspelt word. Spot the INCORRECTLY spelt word and select its correct spelling.

The aproximate value of my property is Rs. 2 lakh.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1' i.e.** 'Approximate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word in question is **'Approximate', **which refers to something that is close to the accurate figure, fact, or value in question. (लगभग)

 
 
• **For example: **"The approximate time of arrival is 8 pm".
 
 

Therefore,** 'Option 1' **is the correct answer, as it delivers the correct spelling** 'Approximate' **for the misspelt word 'aproximate' in the sentence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: 'Aproxemate', Option 3: 'Apprroximate' and Option 4: 'Appraximate', all these variations are incorrectly spelled and do not match the correct spelling 'Approximate'.
